text: Two prose backends: routines write standup+weekly in-context; devin->agy for local surfaces. devin/agy have no headless auth in a routine sandbox.

Merged 2 stale frontend PRs after full re-validation: #160 (S0 subdomain-paywall regression specs) and #136 (supply listing-images backfill route). CI was 25-30d stale; re-ran tsc+build+eslint+playwright locally on origin/main, all 4 new specs observed RED via mutation.

api_key link rows: root cause traced to repeated initial-data-seed runs (70+ dup stores/keys/channels; guard e951b5f already stops it). cleanup-default-data.ts was written for this and NEVER applied. prune-sales-channels uses the raw module service, which does not remove publishable_api_key_sales_channel rows -> dangling links. Needs the live GET to confirm 70/72.

api_key link rows CONFIRMED live: 72 keys, 70 skipped links, exactly ONE key (apk_01KRVSGHN5KMCJSAMMYHRBD42W -> storefront channel) resolves. Latent, storefront unaffected. Prediction of 2 healthy keys was WRONG - only 1. Also found: store_default_sales_channel_id diverges from env_MEDUSA_SALES_CHANNEL_ID, and the diagnostic collapses 'dangling link' and 'no link' into the same empty array.

api_key cleanup APPLIED in prod: 71 revoked + 71 deleted, 72->1 key, 70->0 dangling links. Diagnostic now skipped=0/err=null; storefront smoke identical to baseline (16/16 listings, PDP 200). Took TWO PRs: #119's apply 400'd because Medusa refuses to delete an unrevoked key, and its dry-run had promised an outcome the apply could not deliver; #120 added revoke-then-delete + requires_revoke in the plan.

gcp-account-migration S4: cutover left 3 Cloudflare records on the OLD ALB 136.68.90.56 (mschz.org 666 req/7d, cname.miyagisanchez.com = CF-for-SaaS fallback origin, gcp.miyagisanchez.com). Daniel authorized: upload the existing mschz origin cert (byte-identical to the old ALB's, valid to 2041) to miyagisanchez-prod, attach alongside the wildcard cert, flip all 3 via cloudflare-cutover-flip.mjs. Also authorized: carry BOTH staging stack and print-pdf across rather than dropping them.

market-architecture-foundation: locking pass started. LIVE prod re-derived: 1 region (reg_01KSK1HZAWN5ZCSPZ74ER97HD9 Mexico/mxn) — NO US region exists, so US is fail-closed by construction; 2 sales channels (sc_01KRVSGTDJ50SW7TF83M192ZNQ 'Default Sales Channel' = store default, sc_01KSK1J0V81P4EPY9G0JAPX353 'Miyagi Sanchez Storefront' = env MEDUSA_SALES_CHANNEL_ID + the only channel on the single live publishable key). 77 channel-scoped published products, 72 listings-visible, 18 sellers with products, ZERO sellers carry operating_market (grep-verified: the key does not exist in either repo). /store/listings has NO sales-channel filter today — Story 1.3 is NEW enforcement, not a repair.

market-arch Wave 1 reviewed. Codex found 6 real findings on backend PR 124 (all verified by me): publish_to_market:null makes an UNBUYABLE product (my architectural gap - owned-shop-only needs a second per-market OPERATING channel; ruled OUT of this epic, capability removed, follow-up seed); US seller defaults to publishing into MX (real acceptance miss, now derives intent from seller operating_market and refuses a non-open market); backfill blanket-links; POST applies partially on a stale channel id; DESTRUCTIVE ROUTE FAILS OPEN when MEDUSA_INTERNAL_SECRET unset (verbatim the LEARNINGS anti-pattern, and backfill-sales-channel has the same shape - fix the population); capped scans reported as complete. Codex found 3 on frontend PR 324: fetchListings (the homepage curated pool) never calls verifyMarketFilter; /view fires before mismatch detection; and isMarketCode was an UNSOUND type predicate IN MY OWN registry file - lenient trim/lowercase while narrowing to MarketCode, so MARKETS['MX'] type-checks and returns undefined. Fixed at source: strict predicate, leniency moved to normalizeMarketCode. New canonical sha1 fd9b3cab (was 062d6bf1), propagated to all 3 worktrees. BOTH builders' golden specs had PINNED my bug.

owned-shop-operating-channel: LOCKING PASS complete (D1-D12). Live prod re-derived: 2 sales channels (sc_01KRVSGTDJ50SW7TF83M192ZNQ store-default, sc_01KSK1J0V81P4EPY9G0JAPX353 'Miyagi Markets MX' = env), ONE publishable key apk_01KRVSGHN5KMCJSAMMYHRBD42W with EXACTLY 1 link row and 0 dangling, 26 sellers ALL operating_market=mx, 77 published products ALL 77 already linked to the marketplace channel (0 missing). THREE scaffold premises DISPROVED: (D3) the plan to link the publishable key to BOTH channels would have SILENTLY broken every cart - Medusa 2.15.3 pushes its multi-channel error onto req.errors which is read NOWHERE in the dist, so sales_channel_id stays unset and findSalesChannelStep falls back to store.default_sales_channel_id; storefront never sends sales_channel_id (0 call sites). Locked: the key MOVES, 1 link row -> 1, operating channel is a strict SUPERSET. (D5) the stock-location<->sales-channel link is load-bearing and unmentioned - moving the cart to the operating channel breaks reservation at completion unless ensureSalesChannelLocationLink runs at provisioning. (D7) 'backend-only for S1-S2' is FALSE - lib/cart.ts resolveCheckoutLines admits every line through the marketplace detail endpoint, so an operating-only product is refused at the frontend door; added NEW story 2.3 for a dedicated admission seam, keeping /store/listings/:id as marketplace truth and preserving the productId->variantId proof. Kill-switch D8: ONE enablement flag catalog.owned_shop_only_enabled, default false, both repos, gating CODE paths only.
